test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Shyam starts from Point A and drives 15 km towards the north. He then takes a right turn, drives 5 km, turns right and drives 20 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 10 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 5 km and stops at Point P. How far and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A from Point P in a straight line? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Given:-

1) Shyam starts from Point A and drives 15 km towards the north.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a7f039c8be310aacd28946b1f5a642ec50615b4e825e164704f8c72ab3b1e6f.png] 

2) He then takes a right turn, drives 5 km, turns right and drives 20 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f56df2224ac0e067983b8d5877115c462f1c8f3e5c4e66fc76d76e82b0257442.png] 

3) He then takes a right turn and drives 10 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7d94d7291c8bb8a01cace6a2d8bc3be86d516c4f7f97a3bec08f919028ce7bd.png] 

4) He takes a final right turn, drives 5 km and stops at point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67bac918e7141ddd995fdfe1030d23fae32511853b0c4f82888aab9872738bb2.png] 

5) Distance and direction towards which shyam has to travel to reach point A from point P in a straight line.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e47f2cc1df3a8109aa1a943e934b09f0c0fc7a0f446fd485a2abe8b37b2a6bb7.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"5 km towards the east".**
